name: companion_touch
verifies: fix-59: a companion fighting next to the hero never hurts him (G3 OnTouchDamage bystander filter + DoLogicalDamage friendly fire): Gorn in the party fights an orc right beside the hero; every touch of Gorn's blade on the hero is dropped (touchwatch: spared[Bystander|FriendlyFire], hurtby:Gorn=0, no stumble), also the follow-through swings after the orc went down (no target any more)
notes: The orc is neutral to the hero (it fights Gorn only), so its own stray blows on the hero are dropped as well (Neutral better than Hostile). No god mode: the GodMode gate would hide the damage. The hero stands between Gorn and the orc with nothing drawn. touchwatch logs each landed hit on the hero at once ('touchwatch: X -> hero ...') and the tally at 'touchwatch off'.
steps: spawn Orc_Elite_01 attitude=neutral dist=1.4 side=right as=orc
log -- the orc goes down: Gorn's swings that are still running have no target any more
